title: Play its episode
summary: Plays an episode this persona's pack carries, in the Podcasts applet. The first time it is downloaded into the Podcasts library; after that it plays from this device.
whenToUse: Use when the person asks to play or listen to this persona's podcast or episode. Leave the episode empty unless they named one.

arguments.name: episode
arguments.description: The episode they named; empty for the pack's episode

privateChat.keeps: The episode in your Podcasts library, and your place in it.

_note: Phase FL.10 (2026-11-16): a step for a companion pack (agent.mode "companion"), which chats as a persona and takes a step only when the person asks. It carries no route words: the pack's own `agent.ask` phrases offer it, so the general Agent's router never does.
